courses.title: Lighting and Materials for Realistic Renders
courses.description: Lighting and Materials for Realistic Renders focuses on lighting and materials for people working toward a Architectural Visualiser role, through hands-on exercises and short review checkpoints. It also introduces client presentation, enough to apply alongside lighting and materials in real Architectural Visualiser work. By the end, you'll be able to explain your approach to lighting and materials and show how client presentation supports it.
learning_outcomes: Applying lighting and materials to a real Architectural Visualiser scenario
Practicing lighting and materials through guided exercises
Getting a working introduction to client presentation
Reviewing common mistakes and how to avoid them

courses.title: Animation Basics for Practitioners
courses.description: Animation Basics for Practitioners goes beyond the basics of animation basics, for people already working toward a Architectural Visualiser role. Through a handful of applied exercises and more realistic scenarios, you'll build the kind of judgement that only comes with practice, rather than following a fixed recipe. It's built for people who already have some grounding in animation basics and want to go further.

courses.title: Material Specification in Brief
courses.description: Material Specification in Brief walks you through the basics of material specification, built for people new to Architectural Visualiser work. Starting from the essential vocabulary, you'll work through a handful of guided exercises that build a working sense of material specification, with no prior experience assumed. Expect short, practical lessons rather than a long project, with just enough depth to get you started.
learning_outcomes: Applying material specification to a real Architectural Visualiser scenario
Practicing material specification through guided exercises
